description: The Moon at a moment: phase name and angle, illumination, age, lunar day (30 per lunation by 12° of elongation, with its start time), sign and degree, next sign ingress, whether it is void of course and until when, the next four phases to the minute, and moonrise/moonset when lat and lon are given. Computed live from the ephemeris (astronomy-engine, about 1′), tropical zodiac on the true ecliptic of date, geocentric, UTC. Astronomical positions only, no interpretation. Paid tool: $0.005 per call in USDC on Base via x402 (HTTP 402 with payment requirements; retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Free tools cover the current status and the next retrograde.

date.description: Moment as YYYY-MM-DD (read as 12:00 UTC) or ISO UTC timestamp. Defaults to now.

name: moon_now
title: Moon right now
